title: Madhya-khanda, part 18 (portion 41)
html:
The section "The Lord's Arrival at Shantipura": the lament of Shachi and Vishnupriya on Chandrashekhara's return; the devotees of Navadvipa chant the Name, and the Lord, bound by it, sends Nityananda for them; Nityananda in Navadvipa; Shachi and all the people of Nadia go to Advaita's house; the Lord comes to Shantipura; the meal and kirtana

The Lord's Arrival at Shantipura

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. When Chandrashekhara Acharya returned to Nadia, at the sight of him the fire of Shachi's and Vishnupriya's grief blazed up twice as fierce; lamenting bitterly, they began to question the Acharya about Sriman Mahaprabhu. Meanwhile Bhagavan Gaurahari, the Knower of hearts, [seeing] the anguish of the people of Nadia and wishing to show Himself to them, resolved to come to Shantipura and sent them word of it through Sri Nityananda Prabhu. As soon as Nityananda Prabhu arrived in Nadia, at the sight of Him life returned to the bodies of the people of Nadia, who were wasting away in separation. When Shachidevi began to weep, Nityananda Prabhu consoled her and told her of the Lord's coming to Shantipura. Hearing this news, all the people of Nadia in great joy [came] to the house of Sri Advaita [Acharya], to the feet of Sriman Mahaprabhu, and the Lord received them fittingly. Thus that night passed in great bliss.1

Raga karunashri; disha: "Oh, alas, alas!"

নবদ্বীপে প্রবেশিতে আচার্য-শেখর ।
নয়নে গলয়ে জলধারা নিরন্তর ॥ ১ ॥

nabadbīpe prabeśite ācārya-śekhara |
naẏane galaẏe jaladhārā nirantara || 1 ||

navadvipe praveshite — on entering Navadvipa; acharya-shekhara — Acharya Shekhara (Chandrashekhara); nayane galaye — from his eyes flow; jaladhara nirantara — ceaseless streams of tears

1As Acharya Shekhara entered Navadvipa,
tears flowed ceaselessly from his eyes.

নবদ্বীপবাসী যত তাহারে দেখিয়া ।
অন্তরে পোড়য়ে প্রাণ ধকধক হিয়া ॥ ২ ॥

nabadbīpabāsī yata tāhāre dekhiẏā |
antare poṛaẏe prāṇa dhakadhaka hiẏā || 2 ||

navadvipa-vasi yata — all the people of Navadvipa; tahare dekhiya — seeing him; antare podaye prana — their life burns within; dhakadhaka hiya — their hearts pound

2All the people of Navadvipa, seeing him,
burn within, their hearts pounding.

সকল বৈষ্ণব আসি' মিলিলা সেখানে ।
সম্বরিতে নারে অশ্রু — কাতর বয়ানে ॥ ৩ ॥

sakala baiṣṇaba āsi' mililā sekhāne |
sambarite nāre aśru — kātara baẏāne || 3 ||

sakala vaishnava asi — all the Vaishnavas, coming; milila se-khane — gathered there; samvarite nare ashru — cannot hold back their tears; katara bayane — with stricken faces

3All the Vaishnavas came and gathered there;
unable to hold back their tears, with stricken faces,

পুছিতে না পারে কিছু — মুখে নাহি রায় ।
শুনি' শচীদেবী আউদড়-চুলে ধায় ॥ ৪ ॥

puchite nā pāre kichu — mukhe nāhi rāẏa |
śuni' śacīdebī āudaṛa-cule dhāẏa || 4 ||

puchhite na pare kichhu — they cannot ask anything; mukhe nahi raya — no word comes from their lips; shuni shachidevi — hearing, Shachidevi; audara-chule dhaya — runs with dishevelled hair

4they cannot ask anything — no word comes from their lips.
Hearing [of his return], Shachidevi runs with her hair dishevelled.

'আচার্য' বলিয়া ডাকে উন্মতি পাগলী ।
না দেখিয়া গৌরাঙ্গে হইলা উতরোলী ॥ ৫ ॥

'ācārya' baliẏā ḍāke unmati pāgalī |
nā dekhiẏā gaurāṅge hailā utarolī || 5 ||

acharya baliya dake — she calls "Acharya!"; unmati pagali — frantic, distraught; na dekhiya gaurange — not seeing Gauranga; haila utaroli — became agitated

5Frantic with grief, she calls, "Acharya!" —
and, not seeing Gauranga, she is thrown into turmoil:

আমার নিমাই কোথা থুঞা আইলে তুমি ।
কেমনে মুড়িলে মাথা কোন্ দেশ-ভূমি ॥ ৬ ॥

āmāra nimāi kothā thuñā āile tumi |
kemane muṛile māthā kon deśa-bhūmi || 6 ||

amara nimai kotha thunya — where did you leave my Nimai; aile tumi — and come back; kemane mudile matha — how did He shave His head; kon desha-bhumi — in what land

6"Where have you left my Nimai and come back?
How did He shave His head, in what land?

কোন্ ছার সন্ন্যাসী সে হৃদয় দারুণ ।
বিশ্বম্ভরে মন্ত্র দিতে না হইল করুণ ॥ ৭ ॥

kon chāra sannyāsī se hṛdaẏa dāruṇa |
biśbambhare mantra dite nā haila karuṇa || 7 ||

kon chhara sannyasi se — what wretched sannyasi is he; hridaya daruna — hard of heart; vishvambhare mantra dite — in giving the mantra to Vishvambhara; na haila karuna — felt no pity

7What wretched sannyasi with a cruel heart
felt no pity when giving the mantra to Vishvambhara!2

সে হেন সুন্দর কেশ-লাবণ্য দেখিয়া ।
কোন্ ছার নাপিত সে নিদারুণ হিয়া ॥ ৮ ॥

se hena sundara keśa-lābaṇya dekhiẏā |
kon chāra nāpita se nidāruṇa hiẏā || 8 ||

se hena sundara kesha-lavanya — such loveliness of beautiful hair; dekhiya — seeing; kon chhara napita se — what wretched barber is he; nidaruna hiya — with a pitiless heart

8Seeing such loveliness of beautiful hair, —
what wretched barber with a pitiless heart!

কেমন পাপিষ্ঠ তেন কেশে দিল খুর ।
কেমনে বা জীল সে নিদয়া নিঠুর ॥ ৯ ॥

kemana pāpiṣṭha tena keśe dila khura |
kemane bā jīla se nidaẏā niṭhura || 9 ||

kemana papishtha — what sinner; tena keshe dila khura — put a razor to such hair; kemane va jila se — how did he survive; nidaya nithura — pitiless and cruel

9What sinner put a razor to such hair?
How did he survive, that pitiless, cruel one?

আমার নিমাই কার ঘরে ভিক্ষা কৈল ।
মস্তক মুড়াঞা বাছা কেমন বা হৈল ॥ ১০ ॥

āmāra nimāi kāra ghare bhikṣā kaila |
mastaka muṛāñā bāchā kemana bā haila || 10 ||

amara nimai — my Nimai; kara ghare bhiksha kaila — in whose house did He take alms; mastaka mudanya — having shaved His head; bachha kemana va haila — how does my child look now

10In whose house did my Nimai take alms?
How does my child look with His head shaven?

আর না দেখিব পুত্র বদন তোমার ।
অন্ধকার হৈল মোর সকল সংসার ॥ ১১ ॥

āra nā dekhiba putra badana tomāra |
andhakāra haila mora sakala saṃsāra || 11 ||

ara na dekhiba — I shall no more see; putra badana tomara — your face, son; andhakara haila — has become dark; mora sakala samsara — my whole world

11I shall see your face no more, my son:
my whole world has become dark.

রন্ধন করিয়া আর নাহি দিব ভাত ।
সে হেন শ্রীঅঙ্গে আর নাহি দিব হাত ॥ ১২ ॥

randhana kariẏā āra nāhi diba bhāta |
se hena śrīaṅge āra nāhi diba hāta || 12 ||

randhana kariya — having cooked; ara nahi diba bhata — I shall no more serve you rice; se hena shri-ange — that beautiful body; ara nahi diba hata — I shall no more touch

12No more shall I cook rice to serve you,
no more shall I touch your beautiful body,

সুন্দর-বদনে চুম্ব না দিব মুঞি আর ।
ক্ষুধার সময় কেবা বুঝিবে তোমার ॥ ১৩ ॥

sundara-badane cumba nā diba muñi āra |
kṣudhāra samaẏa kebā bujhibe tomāra || 13 ||

sundara-badane — on the beautiful face; chumba na diba munni ara — I shall kiss no more; kshudhara samaya — when you are hungry; keba bujhibe tomara — who will understand you

13no more shall I kiss your lovely face.
Who will know when you are hungry?"

এতেক বিলাপ যবে শচীদেবী কৈল ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া প্রবোধিতে জন কথো গেল ॥ ১৪ ॥

eteka bilāpa yabe śacīdebī kaila |
biṣṇupriẏā prabodhite jana katho gela || 14 ||

eteka vilapa — such lament; yabe shachidevi kaila — when Shachidevi made; vishnupriya prabodhite — to console Vishnupriya; jana katho gela — some people went

14While Shachidevi was lamenting thus,
some people went to console Vishnupriya.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-কান্দনাতে পৃথিবী বিদরে ।
পশু-পক্ষী-লতা-তরু এ পাষাণ ঝুরে ॥ ১৫ ॥

biṣṇupriẏā-kāndanāte pṛthibī bidare |
paśu-pakṣī-latā-taru e pāṣāṇa jhure || 15 ||

vishnupriya-kandanate — at Vishnupriya's weeping; prithivi vidare — the earth splits; pashu-pakshi-lata-taru — beasts, birds, creepers, trees; e pashana jhure — [and] these stones weep

15At Vishnupriya's weeping the earth splits;
beasts, birds, creepers, trees — even the stones weep.3

হা হা প্রাণনাথ ছাড়ি' গেলে হে নদীয়া ।
অনাথিনী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ায় নিঠুর হইয়া ॥ ১৫+১ ॥

hā hā prāṇanātha chāṛi' gele he nadīẏā |
anāthinī biṣṇupriẏāẏa niṭhura haiẏā || 15+1 ||

ha ha prananatha — alas, alas, Lord of my life; chhadi gele he nadiya — You have left Nadia; anathini vishnupriyaya — to helpless Vishnupriya; nithura haiya — becoming cruel

15+1"Alas, alas, Lord of my life, You have left Nadia,4
cruelly forsaking helpless Vishnupriya!

শ্রীবাসাদি ভক্ত-সঙ্গে কীর্তন-বিহার ।
নয়ন ভরিয়া নৃত্য না দেখিব আর ॥ ১৫+২ ॥

śrībāsādi bhakta-saṅge kīrtana-bihāra |
naẏana bhariẏā nṛtya nā dekhiba āra || 15+2 ||

shrivasa-adi bhakta-sange — with Srivasa and the other devotees; kirtana-vihara — the joy of kirtana; nayana bhariya — to my eyes' fill; nritya na dekhiba ara — I shall no more see [Your] dancing

15+2The joy of kirtana with Srivasa and the other devotees,
Your dancing — I shall not see them to my eyes' fill again.

প্রেমাবেশে গদগদ বোল শ্রীবদনে ।
না শুনিয়া অভাগিনী বাঁচিবে কেমনে ॥ ১৫+৩ ॥

premābeśe gadagada bola śrībadane |
nā śuniẏā abhāginī bāṁcibe kemane || 15+3 ||

premaveshe gadagada bola — the faltering words in prema's rapture; shri-badane — from [Your] beautiful lips; na shuniya — not hearing; abhagini banchibe kemane — how will the unfortunate one live

15+3Not hearing the words from Your beautiful lips, faltering with prema,
how will this unfortunate one live?

কোন্ দেশে কিরূপে বা আছ প্রাণেশ্বর ।
সোঙরি' সোঙরি' প্রাণ হৈল জরজর ॥ ১৫+৪ ॥

kon deśe kirūpe bā ācha prāṇeśbara |
soṅari' soṅari' prāṇa haila jarajara || 15+4 ||

kon deshe kirupe va — in what land and how; achha praneshvara — are You, Lord of my life; songari songari — remembering again and again; prana haila jarajara — my life is worn out

15+4In what land are You, and how, Lord of my life?
I remember and remember — and my life is worn away.

হায় রে কঠিন প্রাণ, না বাহিরাও কেনে ।
জ্বালহ আগুনি — আমি মরিব এখনে ॥ ১৫+৫ ॥

hāẏa re kaṭhina prāṇa, nā bāhirāo kene |
jbālaha āguni — āmi mariba ekhane || 15+5 ||

haya re kathina prana — alas, hard life; na bahirao kene — why do you not depart; jvalaha aguni — kindle a fire; ami mariba ekhane — I shall die at once

15+5Alas, hard life, why do you not depart?
Kindle a fire — I shall die at once!

উদ্বেগে দিবস মোর হৈল কোটি যুগ ।
না দেখিয়া প্রাণনাথ তোর বিধুমুখ ॥ ১৫+৬ ॥

udbege dibasa mora haila koṭi yuga |
nā dekhiẏā prāṇanātha tora bidhumukha || 15+6 ||

udvege — in anguish; divasa mora haila koti yuga — each day of mine has become millions of yugas; na dekhiya prananatha — not seeing, Lord of my life; tora vidhumukha — Your moon-face

15+6In my anguish each day has become as millions of yugas:
I do not see, Lord of my life, Your moon-like face.

জীবমাত্রে উদ্বেগ না দেয় সাধুজন ।
তোর শোকে শচীমাতা ছাড়য়ে জীবন ॥ ১৫+৭ ॥

jībamātre udbega nā deẏa sādhujana |
tora śoke śacīmātā chāṛaẏe jībana || 15+7 ||

jiva-matre — to any living being; udvega na deya sadhu-jana — a saint gives no distress; tora shoke — in grief for You; shachimata chhadaye jivana — Mother Shachi is giving up her life

15+7A saint causes no anguish to any living being, —
yet in grief for You Mother Shachi is giving up her life.

মুঞি অভাগিনী তোমার ভকতি না জানি ।
সেই অপরাধে বুঝি হৈলুঁ অনাথিনী ॥ ১৫+৮ ॥

muñi abhāginī tomāra bhakati nā jāni |
sei aparādhe bujhi hailuṁ anāthinī || 15+8 ||

munni abhagini — I, unfortunate; tomara bhakati na jani — do not know how to serve You with devotion; sei aparadhe bujhi — perhaps for that offence; hailun anathini — I have been left forlorn

15+8Unfortunate, I did not know how to serve You with devotion —
surely for that offence I have been left forlorn.

চরণ-নিকটে প্রভু বসিয়া তোমার ।
রূপ হেরি' হেরি' আমি না জুড়াব আর ॥ ১৫+৯ ॥

caraṇa-nikaṭe prabhu basiẏā tomāra |
rūpa heri' heri' āmi nā juṛāba āra || 15+9 ||

charana-nikate prabhu — near the feet, Lord; basiya tomara — sitting at Your; rupa heri heri — gazing and gazing at [Your] beauty; ami na judaba ara — I shall find solace no more

15+9No more shall I find solace, Lord,
sitting at Your feet and gazing and gazing at Your beauty,

বদনে তুলিয়া দিতে কর্পূর-তাম্বূলে ।
দশন-মুকুতা-পাঁতি পরশি' অঙ্গুলে ॥ ১৫+১০ ॥

badane tuliẏā dite karpūra-tāmbūle |
daśana-mukutā-pāṁti paraśi' aṅgule || 15+10 ||

badane tuliya dite — raising to [Your] lips; karpura-tambule — betel with camphor; dashana-mukuta-panti — the row of pearl-like teeth; parashi angule — touching with my fingers

15+10raising betel with camphor to Your lips,
touching with my fingers the pearl-like row of Your teeth.

অরুণ-নয়ান-কোণে করুণায় চাইয়া ।
মধুর মধুর কথা বলিতে হাসিয়া ॥ ১৫+১১ ॥

aruṇa-naẏāna-koṇe karuṇāẏa cāiẏā |
madhura madhura kathā balite hāsiẏā || 15+11 ||

aruna-nayana-kone — from the corners of reddish eyes; karunaya chaiya — looking tenderly; madhura madhura katha — sweet, sweet words; balite hasiya — You would speak smiling

15+11You would look tenderly from the corners of Your reddish eyes
and, smiling, speak sweet, sweet words.

অধর অরুণ আর তাম্বূলের রাগে ।
দশন-কিরণ মোর হিয়া-মাঝে জাগে ॥ ১৫+১২ ॥

adhara aruṇa āra tāmbūlera rāge |
daśana-kiraṇa mora hiẏā-mājhe jāge || 15+12 ||

adhara aruna — lips reddish; ara tambulera rage — and with the colour of betel; dashana-kirana — the gleam of teeth; mora hiya-majhe jage — rises in my heart

15+12The reddish lips, redder still with betel,
the gleam of the teeth — all rise up in my heart,

তাহাতে অমিয়া-মাখা শ্রীমুখের হাস ।
শ্রবণ-নয়ান মোর জীতে সেই আশ ॥ ১৫+১৩ ॥

tāhāte amiẏā-mākhā śrīmukhera hāsa |
śrabaṇa-naẏāna mora jīte sei āśa || 15+13 ||

tahate amiya-makha — and on it, steeped in nectar; shri-mukhera hasa — the smile of the beautiful face; shravana-nayana mora — my ears and eyes; jite sei asha — live by that hope

15+13and on the face a smile steeped in nectar:
only by the hope of it do my ears and eyes live.

অমিয়া অধিক প্রভু তোর যত গুণ ।
সোঙরিতে এবে সেই ভেল আগুন ॥ ১৫+১৪ ॥

amiẏā adhika prabhu tora yata guṇa |
soṅarite ebe sei bhela āguna || 15+14 ||

amiya adhika — sweeter than nectar; prabhu tora yata guna — Lord, all Your virtues; songarite ebe — now, on remembering; sei bhela aguna — they have turned to fire

15+14All Your virtues, Lord, are sweeter than nectar, —
but now, when I remember them, they have turned to fire.

বিনোদ-বিলাস-রস সুখময় শেজে ।
সে সব সোঙরি' বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া প্রাণ ত্যজে ॥ ১৫+১৫ ॥

binoda-bilāsa-rasa sukhamaẏa śeje |
se saba soṅari' biṣṇupriẏā prāṇa tyaje || 15+15 ||

vinoda-vilasa-rasa — the sweetness of delightful pastimes; sukhamaya sheje — on the happy bed; se saba songari — remembering all that; vishnupriya prana tyaje — Vishnupriya gives up her life

15+15Delightful pastimes and their sweetness, the happy bed, —
remembering all this, Vishnupriya is giving up her life.

হায় হায় কিবা দৈব হৈল আমারে ।
গৌর বিনু আমার সকল আন্ধিয়ারে ॥ ১৬ ॥

hāẏa hāẏa kibā daiba haila āmāre |
gaura binu āmāra sakala āndhiẏāre || 16 ||

haya haya — alas, alas; kiba daiva haila amare — what fate has befallen me; gaura vinu — without Gaura; amara sakala andhiyare — all is dark for me

16Alas, alas, what fate has befallen me!
Without Gaura all is darkness for me.

সে হাস্য, লাবণ্য দেহ না দেখিব আর ।
না শুনিব বচন-চাতুরী সুধাসার ॥ ১৭ ॥

se hāsya, lābaṇya deha nā dekhiba āra |
nā śuniba bacana-cāturī sudhāsāra || 17 ||

se hasya lavanya deha — that smile, the loveliness of the body; na dekhiba ara — I shall see no more; na shuniba — I shall not hear; bachana-chaturi sudhasara — the clever words, essence of nectar

17I shall see that smile, that loveliness of body no more,
I shall not hear the clever words, the essence of nectar.

অনাথিনী করিয়া কোথাকারে গেলা তুমি ।
সোঙরি' তুয়া গুণ নিবেদিয়ে আমি ॥ ১৮ ॥

anāthinī kariẏā kothākāre gelā tumi |
soṅari' tuẏā guṇa nibediẏe āmi || 18 ||

anathini kariya — leaving me forlorn; kothakare gela tumi — where have You gone; songari tuya guna — remembering Your virtues; nivediye ami — I pour out [my grief]

18Leaving me forlorn, where have You gone?
I remember Your virtues and pour out my grief.

কোন্ ভাগ্যবতী সে না তোমারে দেখিয়া ।
নিন্দিল কতেক মোরে কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ॥ ১৯ ॥

kon bhāgyabatī se nā tomāre dekhiẏā |
nindila kateka more kāndiẏā kāndiẏā || 19 ||

kon bhagyavati se na — which fortunate woman did not; tomare dekhiya — who had seen You; nindila kateka more — reproach me so much; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping

19What fortunate woman who had seen You
has not reproached me with tears?

কোন্ অভাগিনী-কোল ছাড়িয়া আইলা ।
খণ্ডব্রতী অভাগিনী কেনে না মরিলা ॥ ২০ ॥

kon abhāginī-kola chāṛiẏā āilā |
khaṇḍabratī abhāginī kene nā marilā || 20 ||

kon abhagini-kola — from the embrace of what unfortunate woman; chhadiya aila — have You gone; khandavrati abhagini — the unfortunate one whose vow is broken; kene na marila — why did she not die

20From the embrace of what unfortunate woman have You gone?
Why did she not die, the unfortunate one whose vow is broken?5

পূজিল তোমার মুখ অনঙ্গ-নয়নে ।
কেমনে ধরিব হিয়া তোমা-অদর্শনে ॥ ২১ ॥

pūjila tomāra mukha anaṅga-naẏane |
kemane dhariba hiẏā tomā-adarśane || 21 ||

pujila tomara mukha — I worshipped Your face; ananga-nayane — with loving eyes; kemane dhariba hiya — how shall I hold my heart; toma-adarshane — not seeing You

21I worshipped Your face with loving eyes —
how shall I hold my heart without seeing You?

বিচ্ছেদে মরিল তোর যত বর-নারী ।
আমি অভাগিনী দেহ এত কাল ধরি ॥ ২২ ॥

bicchede marila tora yata bara-nārī |
āmi abhāginī deha eta kāla dhari || 22 ||

vichchhede marila — have died in separation; tora yata vara-nari — all Your noble women; ami abhagini — I, unfortunate; deha eta kala dhari — have kept this body so long

22All the noble women who love You are dying in separation,6
and I, unfortunate, have kept this body so long.

মরি মরি গৌরাঙ্গসুন্দর কতি গেলা ।
আমি নারী অনাথিনী সহজে অবলা ॥ ২৩ ॥

mari mari gaurāṅgasundara kati gelā |
āmi nārī anāthinī sahaje abalā || 23 ||

mari mari — I die, I die; gauranga-sundara kati gela — where has beautiful Gauranga gone; ami nari anathini — I am a forlorn woman; sahaje abala — weak by nature

23I die, I die — where has beautiful Gauranga gone?
I am a woman, forlorn and weak by nature.

কোন্ দেশে যাব — লাগি পাব কোন্ ঠাঞি ।
যাইতে না দিব কেহো — মরিব এথাই ॥ ২৪ ॥

kon deśe yāba — lāgi pāba kon ṭhāñi |
yāite nā diba keho — mariba ethāi || 24 ||

kon deshe yaba — to what land shall I go; lagi paba kon thanni — where shall I find [You]; yaite na diba keho — no one will let [me] go; mariba ethai — I shall die right here

24To what land shall I go, where shall I find You?
No one will let me go — I shall die right here.

মায়ে অনাথিনী করি' গেলা কোন্ দেশে ।
কেমনে বঞ্চিব তেঁহ তোমার হুতাশে ॥ ২৫ ॥

māẏe anāthinī kari' gelā kon deśe |
kemane bañciba teṁha tomāra hutāśe || 25 ||

maye anathini kari — leaving Your mother forlorn; gela kon deshe — to what land have You gone; kemane vanchiba tenha — how will she live; tomara hutashe — in the fire of grief for You

25Leaving Your mother forlorn, to what land have You gone?
How will she live, burning with longing for You?

পাপিষ্ঠ শরীর মোর প্রাণ নাহি যায় ।
ভূমিতে লোটাঞা দেবী করে হায় হায় ॥ ২৬ ॥

pāpiṣṭha śarīra mora prāṇa nāhi yāẏa |
bhūmite loṭāñā debī kare hāẏa hāẏa || 26 ||

papishtha sharira mora — from my sinful body; prana nahi yaya — life does not depart; bhumite lotanya devi — rolling on the ground, the goddess; kare haya haya — cries "Alas, alas!"

26Life will not leave my sinful body!" —
rolling on the ground, the goddess cries, "Alas, alas!"

বিরহ-অনল-শ্বাস বহে অনিবার ।
অধর শুখায়, কম্প হয় কলেবর ॥ ২৭ ॥

biraha-anala-śbāsa bahe anibāra |
adhara śukhāẏa, kampa haẏa kalebara || 27 ||

viraha-anala-shvasa — breath hot with the fire of separation; bahe anivara — flows ceaselessly; adhara shukhaya — her lips dry up; kampa haya kalevara — her body trembles

27Breath hot with the fire of separation flows ceaselessly;
her lips dry up, her body trembles.

কেশ বাস না সম্বরে ধূলায় পড়িয়া ।
ক্ষণে ক্ষীণ হয় অঙ্গ, রহে ত ফুলিয়া ॥ ২৮ ॥

keśa bāsa nā sambare dhūlāẏa paṛiẏā |
kṣaṇe kṣīṇa haẏa aṅga, rahe ta phuliẏā || 28 ||

kesha vasa na samvare — she tends neither hair nor clothes; dhulaya padiya — lying in the dust; kshane kshina haya anga — now her body grows faint; rahe ta phuliya — now it seems swollen

28Lying in the dust, she tends neither hair nor clothes;
now her body grows faint, now it seems to swell.

ক্ষণে মূর্ছা পায় রাঙ্গা-চরণ-ধেয়ানে ।
সম্বিত সে পায় ক্ষণে অনেক যতনে ॥ ২৯ ॥

kṣaṇe mūrchā pāẏa rāṅgā-caraṇa-dheẏāne |
sambita se pāẏa kṣaṇe aneka yatane || 29 ||

kshane murchchha paya — now she swoons; ranga-charana-dheyane — meditating on [His] reddish feet; samvita se paya kshane — now she comes to herself; aneka yatane — with great effort

29Now she swoons, meditating on His reddish feet,
now with great effort she comes to herself.

'প্রভু প্রভু' বলি' ডাকে ক্ষণে আর্তনাদে ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-কান্দনাতে সর্বজন কান্দে ॥ ৩০ ॥

'prabhu prabhu' bali' ḍāke kṣaṇe ārtanāde |
biṣṇupriẏā-kāndanāte sarbajana kānde || 30 ||

prabhu prabhu bali — crying "Lord, Lord!"; dake kshane artanade — now she calls with a wail; vishnupriya-kandanate — at Vishnupriya's weeping; sarvajana kande — everyone weeps

30Now she calls with a wail, "Lord, Lord!" —
and at Vishnupriya's weeping everyone weeps.

প্রবোধ করিতে যেই যেই জন গেল ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া দেখি' হিয়া পুড়িতে লাগিল ॥ ৩১ ॥

prabodha karite yei yei jana gela |
biṣṇupriẏā dekhi' hiẏā puṛite lāgila || 31 ||

prabodha karite — to console; yei yei jana gela — whoever went; vishnupriya dekhi — seeing Vishnupriya; hiya pudite lagila — their hearts began to burn

31All who went to console her —
seeing Vishnupriya, their hearts began to burn.

গৌরাঙ্গ গৌরাঙ্গ বলি' ডাকে তার কাণে ।
কতক্ষণে বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া পাইলা চেতনে ॥ ৩১+১ ॥

gaurāṅga gaurāṅga bali' ḍāke tāra kāṇe |
katakṣaṇe biṣṇupriẏā pāilā cetane || 31+1 ||

gauranga gauranga bali — "Gauranga, Gauranga!"; dake tara kane — they call into her ear; katakshane — after a while; vishnupriya paila chetane — Vishnupriya regained consciousness

31+1They call into her ear, "Gauranga, Gauranga!"7 —
and after a while Vishnupriya came to herself.

সর্বজন বোলে — হের শুন বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
কি দিব প্রবোধ তোরে, স্থির কর হিয়া ॥ ৩২ ॥

sarbajana bole — hera śuna biṣṇupriẏā |
ki diba prabodha tore, sthira kara hiẏā || 32 ||

sarvajana bole — everyone says; hera shuna vishnupriya — listen, Vishnupriya; ki diba prabodha tore — what consolation can we give you; sthira kara hiya — steady your heart

32Everyone says: "Listen, Vishnupriya,
what consolation can we give you? Steady your heart.

তোর প্রভু তোর আগে কহিয়াছে কথা ।
যথাতথা যাই তোর নিকটে সর্বদা ॥ ৩২+১ ॥

tora prabhu tora āge kahiẏāche kathā |
yathātathā yāi tora nikaṭe sarbadā || 32+1 ||

tora prabhu — your Lord; tora age kahiyachhe katha — has told you this; yathatatha yai — wherever I go; tora nikate sarvada — I am always near you

32+1Your Lord told you:8
'Wherever I go, I am always near you.'

তোর অগোচর নহে তোর প্রভুর কাজ ।
বুঝিয়া প্রবোধ দেহ নিজ-হিয়া-মাঝ ॥ ৩৩ ॥

tora agocara nahe tora prabhura kāja |
bujhiẏā prabodha deha nija-hiẏā-mājha || 33 ||

tora agochara nahe — are not unknown to you; tora prabhura kaja — the doings of your Lord; bujhiya — understanding [this]; prabodha deha nija-hiya-majha — console your own heart

33The doings of your Lord are not unknown to you:
understand this and console your own heart."

প্রবোধিয়া সব ভক্ত একত্র হইয়া ।
বিচার করয়ে গোরাচাঁদের লাগিয়া ॥ ৩৪ ॥

prabodhiẏā saba bhakta ekatra haiẏā |
bicāra karaẏe gorācāṁdera lāgiẏā || 34 ||

prabodhiya — having consoled [her]; saba bhakta ekatra haiya — all the devotees, gathering together; vichara karaye — deliberate; gorachandera lagiya — about Gorachand

34Having consoled her, all the devotees gathered together
and took counsel about Gorachand:

সন্ন্যাস করিল মো-সভারে দুঃখ দিয়া ।
এখানে ছাড়িয়া গেল নিদারুণ হৈয়া ॥ ৩৫ ॥

sannyāsa karila mo-sabhāre duḥkha diẏā |
ekhāne chāṛiẏā gela nidāruṇa haiẏā || 35 ||

sannyasa karila — He took sannyasa; mo-sabhare duhkha diya — causing grief to us all; ekhane chhadiya gela — He left [us] here; nidaruna haiya — becoming pitiless

35"He has taken sannyasa, causing grief to us all,
and pitilessly left us here.

রহিব কেমনে তাঁরে ছাড়িয়া আমরা ।
নিদারুণ মো-সভারে ছাড়িলেন গোরা ॥ ৩৬ ॥

rahiba kemane tāṁre chāṛiẏā āmarā |
nidāruṇa mo-sabhāre chāṛilena gorā || 36 ||

rahiba kemane — how shall we live; tanre chhadiya amara — we, without Him; nidaruna — pitilessly; mo-sabhare chhadilena gora — Gora has left us all

36How shall we live without Him?
Pitilessly Gora has left us all.

তাঁরোধিক দয়াল তাঁহার বড় নাম ।
নাম হৈতে তাঁরে পাই — এই মুখ্য কাম ॥ ৩৭ ॥

tāṁrodhika daẏāla tāṁhāra baṛa nāma |
nāma haite tāṁre pāi — ei mukhya kāma || 37 ||

tanradhika dayala — more merciful than He Himself; tanhara bada nama — is His great name; nama haite tanre pai — through the name we shall attain Him; ei mukhya kama — this is the chief thing

37But His great name is more merciful than He Himself:
through the name we shall attain Him — this is the chief thing.9

তাঁর বাক্য আছে পূর্বে মো-সভার তরে ।
নাম যেই লয় সে পাইব আমারে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

tāṁra bākya āche pūrbe mo-sabhāra tare |
nāma yei laẏa se pāiba āmāre || 38 ||

tanra vakya achhe purve — there is His earlier word; mo-sabhara tare — to all of us; nama yei laya — whoever takes [My] name; se paiba amare — will attain Me

38There is His word, spoken to us before:
'Whoever takes My name will attain Me.'"

এত চিন্তি' নাম লৈতে বসিলা সভাই ।
শচী, বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া আর যত যত যেই ॥ ৩৯ ॥

eta cinti' nāma laite basilā sabhāi |
śacī, biṣṇupriẏā āra yata yata yei || 39 ||

eta chinti — thinking thus; nama laite basila sabhai — all sat down to chant the name; shachi vishnupriya — Shachi, Vishnupriya; ara yata yata yei — and all the others

39Thinking thus, all sat down to chant the name —
Shachi, Vishnupriya and all the others,

কি বালক, বৃদ্ধ কিবা, যুবক-যুবতী ।
নাম লৈতে বসিলা গৌরাঙ্গ করি' গতি ॥ ৪০ ॥

ki bālaka, bṛddha kibā, yubaka-yubatī |
nāma laite basilā gaurāṅga kari' gati || 40 ||

ki balaka — children; vriddha kiba — and the old; yuvaka-yuvati — young men and women; nama laite basila — sat down to chant the name; gauranga kari gati — taking Gauranga as their refuge

40children and the old, young men and women —
sat down to chant the name, taking Gauranga as their refuge.

নামপাশে বান্ধিল গৌরাঙ্গ মত্তসিংহ ।
দাণ্ডাইলা মহাপ্রভু, গতি হৈল ভঙ্গ ॥ ৪১ ॥

nāmapāśe bāndhila gaurāṅga mattasiṃha |
dāṇḍāilā mahāprabhu, gati haila bhaṅga || 41 ||

nama-pashe bandhila — with the noose of the name they bound; gauranga matta-simha — Gauranga, the maddened lion; dandaila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu stopped; gati haila bhanga — His going was broken off

41With the noose of the name they bound Gauranga, the maddened lion:
Mahaprabhu stopped, His going was broken off.10

নিত্যানন্দ-অঙ্গে হেলিয়া রহিলা ।
অরুণ-নয়নে প্রভু কান্দিতে লাগিলা ॥ ৪২ ॥

nityānanda-aṅge heliẏā rahilā |
aruṇa-naẏane prabhu kāndite lāgilā || 42 ||

nityananda-ange heliya — leaning on Nityananda; rahila — He stood; aruna-nayane — with reddened eyes; prabhu kandite lagila — the Lord began to weep

42Leaning on Nityananda, He stood
and wept, His eyes reddened.

যাহ নিত্যানন্দ নবদ্বীপে আজি তুমি ।
শান্তিপুরে সভারে দেখিয়ে যেন আমি ॥ ৪৩ ॥

yāha nityānanda nabadbīpe āji tumi |
śāntipure sabhāre dekhiẏe yena āmi || 43 ||

yaha nityananda — go, Nityananda; navadvipe aji tumi — you, today, to Navadvipa; shantipure sabhare — everyone in Shantipura; dekhiye yena ami — so that I may see

43"Go to Navadvipa today, Nityananda,
so that I may see everyone at Shantipura."

শুনি' নিত্যানন্দ মনে আনন্দ হইল ।
দেখা দিব সভাকারে — এই সত্য কৈল ॥ ৪৪ ॥

śuni' nityānanda mane ānanda haila |
dekhā diba sabhākāre — ei satya kaila || 44 ||

shuni nityananda — hearing, Nityananda; mane ananda haila — rejoiced at heart; dekha diba sabhakare — "I will show Myself to all"; ei satya kaila — thus [the Lord] gave His word

44Hearing this, Nityananda rejoiced at heart,
and [the Lord] gave His word: "I will show Myself to all."

কহয়ে লোচনদাস কাতর-হিয়ায় ।
তবে প্রভু গোরাচাঁদ করিলা বিজয় ॥ ৪৫ ॥

kahaẏe locanadāsa kātara-hiẏāẏa |
tabe prabhu gorācāṁda karilā bijaẏa || 45 ||

kahaye lochanadasa — says Lochana Dasa; katara-hiyaya — with a grieving heart; tabe prabhu gorachanda — then the Lord Gorachand; karila vijaya — set out

45With a grieving heart Lochana Dasa says:
then the Lord Gorachand set out.

শ্রীনিত্যানন্দ প্রভু সঙ্গে চলি' যায় ।
হাসিয়া ঠাকুর তাঁরে দিলেন বিদায় ॥ ৪৬ ॥

śrīnityānanda prabhu saṅge cali' yāẏa |
hāsiẏā ṭhākura tāṁre dilena bidāẏa || 46 ||

shri-nityananda prabhu — Sri Nityananda Prabhu; sange chali yaya — goes along [with the Lord]; hasiya thakura — the Lord, smiling; tanre dilena vidaya — sent Him off

46Sri Nityananda Prabhu goes along with Him;11
the Lord, smiling, sent Him off:

নবদ্বীপ যাহ তুমি — শুনহ বচন ।
নদিয়ানগরে মোর যত বন্ধুজন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

nabadbīpa yāha tumi — śunaha bacana |
nadiẏānagare mora yata bandhujana || 47 ||

navadvipa yaha tumi — go to Navadvipa; shunaha bachana — hear [My] word; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; mora yata bandhu-jana — all My dear ones

47"Go to Navadvipa, hear My word:
to all My dear ones in the town of Nadia

সভারে কহিও মোর 'নারায়ণ'-বাণী ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-ঘরে উত্তরিব আমি ॥ ৪৮ ॥

sabhāre kahio mora 'nārāẏaṇa'-bāṇī |
adbaita-ācārya-ghare uttariba āmi || 48 ||

sabhare kahio — tell everyone; mora narayana-vani — My [greeting] "Narayana"; advaita-acharya-ghare — at Advaita Acharya's house; uttariba ami — I shall stay

48give My greeting, 'Narayana':12
I shall stay at the house of Advaita Acharya.

সভারে লইয়া তুমি আইস তথাকারে ।
একত্রে হইবে দেখা আচার্যের ঘরে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

sabhāre laiẏā tumi āisa tathākāre |
ekatre haibe dekhā ācāryera ghare || 49 ||

sabhare laiya — bringing everyone; tumi aisa tathakare — come there; ekatre haibe dekha — we shall all meet together; acharyera ghare — at the Acharya's house

49Bring everyone and come there —
we shall all meet together at the Acharya's house."

ইহা বলি' মহাপ্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
নিত্যানন্দ যান তবে নদিয়ানগর ॥ ৫০ ॥

ihā bali' mahāprabhu calilā satbara |
nityānanda yāna tabe nadiẏānagara || 50 ||

iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu chalila satvara — Mahaprabhu went on quickly; nityananda yana tabe — and Nityananda then goes; nadiya-nagara — to the town of Nadia

50Saying this, Mahaprabhu went on quickly,
and Nityananda goes to the town of Nadia.

নদিয়ানগরের লোক জীয়ন্তেতে মরা ।
কাটিলে কুটিলে রক্ত-মাংস নাহি তারা ॥ ৫১ ॥

nadiẏānagarera loka jīẏantete marā |
kāṭile kuṭile rakta-māṃsa nāhi tārā || 51 ||

nadiya-nagarera loka — the people of the town of Nadia; jiyantete mara — are dead while living; katile kutile — cut them, chop them; rakta-mamsa nahi tara — there is no blood or flesh in them

51The people of the town of Nadia are dead while living:
cut them, chop them — there is no blood or flesh in them;

উদরে নাহিক অন্ন — টলমল তনু ।
সর্ব অন্ধকার তারা গোরাচাঁদ বিনু ॥ ৫২ ॥

udare nāhika anna — ṭalamala tanu |
sarba andhakāra tārā gorācāṁda binu || 52 ||

udare nahika anna — no food in their stomachs; talamala tanu — their bodies totter; sarva andhakara tara — all is darkness for them; gorachanda vinu — without Gorachand

52no food in their stomachs, their bodies totter —
without Gorachand all is darkness to them.

আচম্বিতে নিত্যানন্দ নদিয়ানগরে ।
গায়ে বল হৈল — সভে ধাইল সত্বরে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

ācambite nityānanda nadiẏānagare |
gāẏe bala haila — sabhe dhāila satbare || 53 ||

achambite nityananda — suddenly Nityananda; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; gaye bala haila — strength came into their bodies; sabhe dhaila satvare — all ran [to Him] quickly

53Suddenly — Nityananda in the town of Nadia!
Strength came into their bodies, and all ran to Him quickly.

চলিতে না পারে পথে টলমল করে ।
দেখিতে না পায় পথ নয়নের জলে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

calite nā pāre pathe ṭalamala kare |
dekhite nā pāẏa patha naẏanera jale || 54 ||

chalite na pare — they cannot walk; pathe talamala kare — they totter on the road; dekhite na paya patha — they cannot see the road; nayanera jale — for the tears in their eyes

54They cannot walk, they totter on the road,
they cannot see the way for their tears.

সকল বৈষ্ণব কান্দে পড়িয়া চরণে ।
পুছিতে না পারে কিছু, নিরখে বদনে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

sakala baiṣṇaba kānde paṛiẏā caraṇe |
puchite nā pāre kichu, nirakhe badane || 55 ||

sakala vaishnava kande — all the Vaishnavas weep; padiya charane — falling at [His] feet; puchhite na pare kichhu — they cannot ask anything; nirakhe badane — they gaze at [His] face

55All the Vaishnavas weep, falling at His feet;
they cannot ask anything — they only gaze at His face.

শচী অতি উনমতি ধায় ঊর্ধ্বমুখে ।
এ ভূমি-আকাশ শচীর জুড়িলেক দুঃখে ॥ ৫৬ ॥

śacī ati unamati dhāẏa ūrdhbamukhe |
e bhūmi-ākāśa śacīra juṛileka duḥkhe || 56 ||

shachi ati unamati — Shachi, utterly frantic; dhaya urdhvamukhe — runs with her face upturned; e bhumi-akasha — this earth and sky; shachira judileka duhkhe — Shachi's grief filled

56Shachi, utterly frantic, runs with her face turned to the sky;
Shachi's grief filled earth and sky.

আর্তনাদে ডাকে শচী — আরে অবধূত ।
কোথা থুঞা আইলা মোর নিমাই সোনা-সুত ॥ ৫৭ ॥

ārtanāde ḍāke śacī — āre abadhūta |
kothā thuñā āilā mora nimāi sonā-suta || 57 ||

artanade dake shachi — Shachi calls with a wail; are avadhuta — O Avadhuta; kotha thunya aila — where have you left and come; mora nimai sona-suta — my Nimai, my golden son

57With a wail Shachi calls: "O Avadhuta,
where have you left my Nimai, my golden son, and come back?"

ইহা বলি' কান্দে শচী বুকে কর হানে ।
টলমল করে, নাহি চাহে পথ-পানে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

ihā bali' kānde śacī buke kara hāne |
ṭalamala kare, nāhi cāhe patha-pāne || 58 ||

iha bali kande shachi — saying this, Shachi weeps; buke kara hane — beats her breast; talamala kare — she totters; nahi chahe patha-pane — she does not look to the road

58Saying this, Shachi weeps and beats her breast;
she totters, not looking to the road.

শচী দেখি' অভ্যুত্থান করিলা ঠাকুর ।
শচী কহে — মোর পুত্র আইলে কতদূর ॥ ৫৯ ॥

śacī dekhi' abhyutthāna karilā ṭhākura |
śacī kahe — mora putra āile katadūra || 59 ||

shachi dekhi — seeing Shachi; abhyutthana karila thakura — Thakura (Nityananda) rose [to greet her]; shachi kahe — Shachi says; mora putra aile katadura — how far has my son come

59Seeing Shachi, Thakura rose to greet her.13
Shachi says: "How far off is my son?"

নিত্যানন্দ কহে — খেদ না করিহ চিতে ।
আমারে পাঠাইল তোমা-সভাকারে নিতে ॥ ৬০ ॥

nityānanda kahe — kheda nā kariha cite |
āmāre pāṭhāila tomā-sabhākāre nite || 60 ||

nityananda kahe — Nityananda says; kheda na kariha chite — do not grieve at heart; amare pathaila — He has sent me; toma-sabhakare nite — to bring you all

60Nityananda says: "Do not grieve at heart:
He has sent me to bring you all.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-ঘরে রহিব ঠাকুর ।
খেদ না করিহ, দেখা হইব অদূর ॥ ৬১ ॥

adbaita-ācārya-ghare rahiba ṭhākura |
kheda nā kariha, dekhā haiba adūra || 61 ||

advaita-acharya-ghare — at Advaita Acharya's house; rahiba thakura — the Lord will stay; kheda na kariha — do not grieve; dekha haiba adura — you will see Him soon

61The Lord will stay at Advaita Acharya's house.
Do not grieve — you will see Him soon.

চলহ সকল লোক প্রভু দেখিবারে ।
সেইমতে সেইক্ষণে সর্বজন চলে ॥ ৬২ ॥

calaha sakala loka prabhu dekhibāre |
seimate seikṣaṇe sarbajana cale || 62 ||

chalaha sakala loka — come, everyone; prabhu dekhibare — to see the Lord; seimate seikshane — thus, at that very moment; sarvajana chale — everyone sets out

62Come, everyone, to see the Lord!" —
and at that very moment everyone set out:

আবাল-বৃদ্ধ, যুবতী, মূক, ধীর জন ।
মূর্খ কিবা তপস্বী — চলিলা সর্বজন ॥ ৬৩ ॥

ābāla-bṛddha, yubatī, mūka, dhīra jana |
mūrkha kibā tapasbī — calilā sarbajana || 63 ||

abala-vriddha — from children to the old; yuvati muka dhira jana — young women, the mute, the sober; murkha kiba tapasvi — the ignorant and ascetics; chalila sarvajana — everyone set out

63from children to the old, young women, the mute, the sober,
the ignorant and the ascetics — everyone set out.

শচী আগে আগে ধায় গায়ে হৈল বল ।
আনন্দে চলিয়া যায় বৈষ্ণব সকল ॥ ৬৪ ॥

śacī āge āge dhāẏa gāẏe haila bala |
ānande caliẏā yāẏa baiṣṇaba sakala || 64 ||

shachi age age dhaya — Shachi runs ahead; gaye haila bala — strength came into her body; anande chaliya yaya — joyfully go; vaishnava sakala — all the Vaishnavas

64Shachi runs ahead — strength has come into her body;
joyfully all the Vaishnavas go along.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-ঘরে উত্তরিল গিয়া ।
ভাঙ্গিল কাঁকালি তারা প্রভু না দেখিয়া ॥ ৬৫ ॥

adbaita-ācārya-ghare uttarila giẏā |
bhāṅgila kāṁkāli tārā prabhu nā dekhiẏā || 65 ||

advaita-acharya-ghare — at Advaita Acharya's house; uttarila giya — they arrived; bhangila kankali tara — they were crushed (lit. "their backs broke"); prabhu na dekhiya — not seeing the Lord

65Arriving at Advaita Acharya's house
and not seeing the Lord, they lost heart.14

অদ্বৈত-আচার্যে কথা পুছে নিত্যানন্দ ।
তোমার আশ্রমে প্রভু করিলা নির্বন্ধ ॥ ৬৬ ॥

adbaita-ācārye kathā puche nityānanda |
tomāra āśrame prabhu karilā nirbandha || 66 ||

advaita-acharye katha — with Advaita Acharya; puchhe nityananda — Nityananda speaks; tomara ashrame — at Your abode; prabhu karila nirbandha — the Lord has resolved [to stay]

66Nityananda says to Advaita Acharya:
"The Lord has resolved to stay at Your abode.

আমারে পাঠাঞা দিল এ সভারে নিতে ।
আর কিছু না জানিয়ে কি আছয়ে চিতে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

āmāre pāṭhāñā dila e sabhāre nite |
āra kichu nā jāniẏe ki āchaẏe cite || 67 ||

amare pathanya dila — He sent me; e sabhare nite — to bring all these; ara kichhu na janiye — I know nothing more; ki achhaye chite — of what is in His heart

67He sent me to bring all these;
what more is in His heart I do not know."

ইহা বলি' দোঁহে মেলি' করে কোলাকুলি ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-সন্ন্যাস শুনি' অদ্বৈত বিকলি ॥ ৬৮ ॥

ihā bali' doṁhe meli' kare kolākuli |
gaurāṅga-sannyāsa śuni' adbaita bikali || 68 ||

iha bali — saying this; donhe meli — the two together; kare kolakuli — embrace; gauranga-sannyasa shuni — hearing of Gauranga's sannyasa; advaita vikali — Advaita is distraught

68Saying this, the two embrace;
hearing of Gauranga's sannyasa, Advaita is distraught:

মুঞি অভাগিয়া সঙ্গ না পাইল তাঁর ।
কবে চাঁদমুখ মুঞি দেখিব আরবার ॥ ৬৯ ॥

muñi abhāgiẏā saṅga nā pāila tāṁra |
kabe cāṁdamukha muñi dekhiba ārabāra || 69 ||

munni abhagiya — I, unfortunate; sanga na paila tanra — did not have His company; kabe chandamukha — when [His] moon-face; munni dekhiba arabara — shall I see again

69"Unfortunate that I am, I was not with Him.
When shall I see His moon-like face again?"

শচী উনমতি পুছে তখনি-তখন ।
সর্বজন বোলে — প্রভু আসিব এখন ॥ ৭০ ॥

śacī unamati puche takhani-takhana |
sarbajana bole — prabhu āsiba ekhana || 70 ||

shachi unamati — frantic Shachi; puchhe takhani-takhana — asks again and again; sarvajana bole — everyone says; prabhu asiba ekhana — the Lord will come now

70Frantic, Shachi keeps asking again and again,
and everyone says: "The Lord will come any moment."

উৎকণ্ঠা বাঢ়িল সর্বজনার হৃদয় ।
আইলা ত মহাপ্রভু হেনই সময় ॥ ৭১ ॥

utkaṇṭhā bāṛhila sarbajanāra hṛdaẏa |
āilā ta mahāprabhu henai samaẏa || 71 ||

utkantha badhila — eagerness grew; sarvajanara hridaya — in everyone's heart; aila ta mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu came; henai samaya — at that very time

71Eagerness grew in everyone's heart —
and at that very time Mahaprabhu came.15

আছিল-অধিক কোটিগুণ দেহ-ছটা ।
আর তাহে উজ্জ্বল চন্দন-দীর্ঘ-ফোঁটা ॥ ৭২ ॥

āchila-adhika koṭiguṇa deha-chaṭā |
āra tāhe ujjbala candana-dīrgha-phoṁṭā || 72 ||

achhila-adhika kotiguna — millions of times more than before; deha-chhata — the radiance of His body; ara tahe ujjvala — and on it a bright; chandana-dirgha-phonta — long mark of sandal

72The radiance of His body was millions of times greater than before,
and on it a bright, long mark of sandal.

গোরা-গায়ে অরুণ-বসন উজিয়ার ।
প্রাতঃকালের সূর্য জিনি' বরণ তাহার ॥ ৭৩ ॥

gorā-gāẏe aruṇa-basana ujiẏāra |
prātaḥkālera sūrya jini' baraṇa tāhāra || 73 ||

gora-gaye — on the golden body; aruna-vasana ujiyara — the reddish cloth shines; pratah-kalera surya jini — surpassing the morning sun; varana tahara — is its colour

73On the golden body the reddish cloth shines,
surpassing in colour the morning sun.

দণ্ড-করে আইসে প্রভু সিংহের গমনে ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক পড়িলা চরণে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

daṇḍa-kare āise prabhu siṃhera gamane |
dekhiẏā sakala loka paṛilā caraṇe || 74 ||

danda-kare — staff in hand; aise prabhu — the Lord comes; simhera gamane — with a lion's gait; dekhiya sakala loka padila charane — seeing Him, all the people fell at [His] feet

74Staff in hand, the Lord comes with a lion's gait;
seeing Him, all the people fell at His feet.

হিয়া জুড়াইল দেখি' অঙ্গের ছটাক ।
পাশরিল সর্বলোক দুঃখ লাখে লাখ ॥ ৭৫ ॥

hiẏā juṛāila dekhi' aṅgera chaṭāka |
pāśarila sarbaloka duḥkha lākhe lākha || 75 ||

hiya judaila — hearts were soothed; dekhi angera chhataka — seeing the radiance of [His] body; pasharila sarvaloka — everyone forgot; duhkha lakhe lakha — hundreds of thousands of sorrows

75Seeing the radiance of His body, their hearts were soothed,
and all forgot hundreds of thousands of sorrows.

আনন্দে ভরল হিয়া, নাহি শোক দুখ ।
একদৃষ্টে চাহে সভে বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখ ॥ ৭৫+১ ॥

ānande bharala hiẏā, nāhi śoka dukha |
ekadṛṣṭe cāhe sabhe biśbambhara-mukha || 75+1 ||

anande bharala hiya — hearts filled with joy; nahi shoka dukha — no sorrow or grief; ekadrishte chahe sabhe — all gaze fixedly; vishvambhara-mukha — at Vishvambhara's face

75+1Hearts filled with joy — no sorrow, no grief;16
all gaze fixedly at Vishvambhara's face.

প্রাণ হারাইলে যেন প্রাণ পায় জনে ।
ধন হারাইলে যেন ধনী পায় ধনে ॥ ৭৫+২ ॥

prāṇa hārāile yena prāṇa pāẏa jane |
dhana hārāile yena dhanī pāẏa dhane || 75+2 ||

prana haraile — having lost life; yena prana paya jane — as a man regains life; dhana haraile — having lost wealth; yena dhani paya dhane — as a rich man regains his wealth

75+2As a man who has lost his life regains life,
as a rich man who has lost his wealth regains his wealth,

পতি হারাইলে যেন পতিব্রতাগণ ।
সুখী যেন পাইয়া পুনর্বার দরশন ॥ ৭৫+৩ ॥

pati hārāile yena patibratāgaṇa |
sukhī yena pāiẏā punarbāra daraśana || 75+3 ||

pati haraile — having lost their husbands; yena pativrata-gana — as faithful wives; sukhi yena — are happy, as; paiya punarbara darashana — on seeing them again

75+3as faithful wives who have lost their husbands
are happy to see them again,

জল ছাড়ি' মৎস্য যেন ছটফট করে ।
আচম্বিতে জল পাইলে যেন কুতূহলে ॥ ৭৫+৪ ॥

jala chāṛi' matsya yena chaṭaphaṭa kare |
ācambite jala pāile yena kutūhale || 75+4 ||

jala chhadi — out of water; matsya yena chhatphata kare — as a fish struggles; achambite jala paile — and, suddenly finding water; yena kutuhale — how it rejoices

75+4as a fish that struggles out of water
rejoices when suddenly it finds water —

এইমত সব জন গৌরাঙ্গ দেখিয়া ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ হরষিত হিয়া ॥ ৭৫+৫ ॥

eimata saba jana gaurāṅga dekhiẏā |
pulake ākula aṅga haraṣita hiẏā || 75+5 ||

eimata saba jana — thus all the people; gauranga dekhiya — seeing Gauranga; pulake akula anga — bodies thrilling; harashita hiya — hearts rejoicing

75+5so all the people, seeing Gauranga,
thrill in every limb, their hearts rejoicing.

প্রেমায় ভরিল হিয়া — নাহি শোক দুঃখ ।
একদৃষ্টে চাহে শচী বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখ ॥ ৭৬ ॥

premāẏa bharila hiẏā — nāhi śoka duḥkha |
ekadṛṣṭe cāhe śacī biśbambhara-mukha || 76 ||

premaya bharila hiya — her heart filled with prema; nahi shoka duhkha — no sorrow or grief; ekadrishte chahe shachi — Shachi gazes fixedly; vishvambhara-mukha — at Vishvambhara's face

76Shachi's heart filled with prema — no sorrow, no grief;
she gazes fixedly at Vishvambhara's face.

আইস আইস বাপ হাপুতীর পুত ।
অনাথিনী করি' কোথা গিয়াছিলা সুত ॥ ৭৬+১ ॥

āisa āisa bāpa hāputīra puta |
anāthinī kari' kothā giẏāchilā suta || 76+1 ||

aisa aisa bapa — come, come, my son; haputira puta — son of a mother bereft of her children; anathini kari — leaving [me] forlorn; kotha giyachhila suta — where did you go, son

76+1"Come, come, my son, son of a mother bereft of her children!17
Leaving me forlorn, where did you go?

ঘরে লৈয়া যাব তোরে রাখিব সম্বরি' ।
সন্ন্যাসের বেশ তোর সব পরিহরি' ॥ ৭৬+২ ॥

ghare laiẏā yāba tore rākhiba sambari' |
sannyāsera beśa tora saba parihari' || 76+2 ||

ghare laiya yaba tore — I shall take you home; rakhiba samvari — and keep you safe; sannyasera vesha tora — your sannyasi dress; saba parihari — removing it all

76+2I shall take you home and keep you safe,
removing all your sannyasi dress."

মায়ের কান্দনা দেখি' জগত-ঈশ্বর ।
দণ্ডবত হৈয়া পড়িলা বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৭৬+৩ ॥

māẏera kāndanā dekhi' jagata-īśbara |
daṇḍabata haiẏā paṛilā biśbambhara || 76+3 ||

mayera kandana dekhi — seeing His mother's weeping; jagata-ishvara — the Lord of the world; dandavata haiya — prostrating like a staff; padila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara fell [at her feet]

76+3Seeing His mother weep, the Lord of the world,
Vishvambhara, fell before her like a staff

মায়েরে কহয় — আর না কান্দহ তুমি ।
তোমার কান্দনায় চিত্তে দুঃখ পাই আমি ॥ ৭৬+৪ ॥

māẏere kahaẏa — āra nā kāndaha tumi |
tomāra kāndanāẏa citte duḥkha pāi āmi || 76+4 ||

mayere kahaya — He says to His mother; ara na kandaha tumi — weep no more; tomara kandanaya — at your weeping; chitte duhkha pai ami — My heart is pained

76+4and says to His mother: "Weep no more:
your weeping pains My heart."

ইহা বলি' শোক দূর কৈল ভগবান্ ।
শচীহ আপন শোক কৈল নিবারণ ॥ ৭৬+৫ ॥

ihā bali' śoka dūra kaila bhagabān |
śacīha āpana śoka kaila nibāraṇa || 76+5 ||

iha bali — saying this; shoka dura kaila bhagavan — Bhagavan dispelled [her] grief; shachiha apana shoka — and Shachi her own grief; kaila nivarana — checked

76+5Saying this, Bhagavan dispelled her grief,
and Shachi checked her sorrow.

যতেক আছিল দুঃখ কিছু নাহি চিতে ।
অমিয়া সিঞ্চিল মুখ দেখিতে দেখিতে ॥ ৭৭ ॥

yateka āchila duḥkha kichu nāhi cite |
amiẏā siñcila mukha dekhite dekhite || 77 ||

yateka achhila duhkha — all the grief there was; kichhu nahi chite — is gone from the heart; amiya sinchila — nectar sprinkled [them]; mukha dekhite dekhite — as they gazed and gazed at [His] face

77All the grief there had been left their hearts:
His face, as they gazed at it, sprinkled them with nectar.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি আনন্দ-হিয়ায় ।
দিব্যাসনে বসাইলা প্রভু গোরারায় ॥ ৭৮ ॥

adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi ānanda-hiẏāẏa |
dibyāsane basāilā prabhu gorārāẏa || 78 ||

advaita-acharya-gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; ananda-hiyaya — with a joyful heart; divyasane basaila — seated on a splendid seat; prabhu goraraya — the Lord Gora Raya

78Advaita Acharya Gosani, with a joyful heart,
seated the Lord Gora Raya on a splendid seat.

পাদপ্রক্ষালন করি' মুছিয়া বসনে ।
পাদোদক পান কৈল সব নিজজনে ॥ ৭৯ ॥

pādaprakṣālana kari' muchiẏā basane |
pādodaka pāna kaila saba nijajane || 79 ||

pada-prakshalana kari — washing [His] feet; muchhiya vasane — wiping them with cloth; padodaka pana kaila — drank the water from [His] feet; saba nijajane — all His own people

79Washing His feet and wiping them with cloth,
all His own people drank the water from His feet.

জয় জয় ধ্বনি শুনি' হরি হরি বোল ।
সকল বৈষ্ণব-হিয়া আনন্দ-হিল্লোল ॥ ৮০ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa dhbani śuni' hari hari bola |
sakala baiṣṇaba-hiẏā ānanda-hillola || 80 ||

jaya jaya dhvani shuni — cries of "Jaya, jaya!" are heard; hari hari bola — "Hari, Hari!"; sakala vaishnava-hiya — in all the Vaishnavas' hearts; ananda-hillola — waves of bliss

80Cries of "Jaya, jaya!" and "Hari, Hari!" resound —
waves of bliss in the hearts of all the Vaishnavas.

তেজ দেখি' আনন্দিত হৈলা হরিদাস ।
মুরারি, মুকুন্দ দত্ত আর শ্রীনিবাস ॥ ৮১ ॥

teja dekhi' ānandita hailā haridāsa |
murāri, mukunda datta āra śrīnibāsa || 81 ||

teja dekhi — seeing [His] effulgence; anandita haila haridasa — Haridasa rejoiced; murari mukunda datta — Murari, Mukunda Datta; ara shrinivasa — and Srinivasa

81Seeing His effulgence, Haridasa rejoiced,
and Murari, Mukunda Datta and Srinivasa.

দণ্ড-পরণাম করে ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ।
ছলছল করে আঁখি বদন দেখিয়া ॥ ৮২ ॥

daṇḍa-paraṇāma kare bhūmite paṛiẏā |
chalachala kare āṁkhi badana dekhiẏā || 82 ||

danda-paranama kare — they prostrate like staffs; bhumite padiya — falling on the ground; chhalachhala kare ankhi — their eyes brim; badana dekhiya — seeing [His] face

82Falling on the ground, they prostrate like staffs;
seeing His face, their eyes brim with tears.

আনন্দ-গদগদ স্বর, অঙ্গ পুলকিত ।
মৈল-শরীরে জীউ আইল আচম্বিত ॥ ৮৩ ॥

ānanda-gadagada sbara, aṅga pulakita |
maila-śarīre jīu āila ācambita || 83 ||

ananda-gadagada svara — voices choked with joy; anga pulakita — bodies thrilling; maila-sharire — into dead bodies; jiu aila achambita — life suddenly returned

83Their voices are choked with joy, their bodies thrill:
life suddenly returned to dead bodies.

হেনমতে নিজজনে দেখি' গোরারায় ।
কৃপাদিঠে চাহে — দয়া বাঢ়িল হিয়ায় ॥ ৮৪ ॥

henamate nijajane dekhi' gorārāẏa |
kṛpādiṭhe cāhe — daẏā bāṛhila hiẏāẏa || 84 ||

henamate — thus; nijajane dekhi goraraya — Gora Raya, seeing His own; kripa-dithe chahe — looks with a merciful glance; daya badhila hiyaya — compassion swelled in His heart

84Thus Gora Raya, seeing His own,
looks on them with a merciful glance — compassion swells in His heart.

কারে নিজ করে প্রভু পরশন করে ।
হাসিয়া সম্ভাষে, কাহো কোলে চাপি' ধরে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

kāre nija kare prabhu paraśana kare |
hāsiẏā sambhāṣe, kāho kole cāpi' dhare || 85 ||

kare nija kare — some with His own hand; prabhu parashana kare — the Lord touches; hasiya sambhashe — He greets smiling; kaho kole chapi dhare — some He clasps to His breast

85Some the Lord touches with His own hand,
some He greets with a smile, some He clasps to His breast —

যার যেই অভিমত করয়ে ঠাকুর ।
সভার অন্তরে প্রেমা বাঢ়িল প্রচুর ॥ ৮৬ ॥

yāra yei abhimata karaẏe ṭhākura |
sabhāra antare premā bāṛhila pracura || 86 ||

yara yei abhimata — whatever each one desired; karaye thakura — the Lord does; sabhara antare — in everyone's heart; prema badhila prachura — prema grew abundantly

86the Lord fulfils each one's desire,
and prema grew abundantly in everyone's heart.

হৃষ্ট হৈলা সর্বজন, দূরে গেল শোক ।
আনন্দে মঙ্গলধ্বনি হরি বোলে লোক ॥ ৮৭ ॥

hṛṣṭa hailā sarbajana, dūre gela śoka |
ānande maṅgaladhbani hari bole loka || 87 ||

hrishta haila sarvajana — everyone was delighted; dure gela shoka — grief went far away; anande mangala-dhvani — joyfully, auspicious cries; hari bole loka — the people cry "Hari!"

87Everyone was delighted, grief went far away;
joyfully the people raise the auspicious cry of "Hari!"

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি ভক্ত সুচতুর ।
তাঁহার আশ্রমে ভিক্ষা করিলা ঠাকুর ॥ ৮৮ ॥

adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi bhakta sucatura |
tāṁhāra āśrame bhikṣā karilā ṭhākura || 88 ||

advaita-acharya-gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; bhakta suchatura — the wise devotee; tanhara ashrame — at his abode; bhiksha karila thakura — the Lord took His meal

88At the abode of the wise devotee Advaita Acharya Gosani
the Lord took His meal.18

পাক কৈল শচীমাতা জগত-জননী ।
আনন্দে ভাসিলা সীতাদেবী নারায়ণী ॥ ৮৮+১ ॥

pāka kaila śacīmātā jagata-jananī |
ānande bhāsilā sītādebī nārāẏaṇī || 88+1 ||

paka kaila shachimata — Mother Shachi cooked; jagata-janani — the mother of the world; anande bhasila — floated in bliss; sita-devi narayani — Sita-devi [and] Narayani

88+1Mother Shachi, the mother of the world, cooked;19
Sita-devi and Narayani floated in bliss.

ভোজন করায় অদ্বৈত বড় পরিপাটী ।
সকল ব্যঞ্জন পাত্রে দিল মিঠি মিঠি ॥ ৮৮+২ ॥

bhojana karāẏa adbaita baṛa paripāṭī |
sakala byañjana pātre dila miṭhi miṭhi || 88+2 ||

bhojana karaya advaita — Advaita serves the meal; bada paripati — with great care; sakala vyanjana — all the dishes; patre dila mithi mithi — He placed on the leaf, sweet and delicious

88+2Advaita serves [the Lord] with great care:
all the dishes, most delicious, He placed on His leaf.

ভোজন করয়ে প্রভু ত্রিদশের রায় ।
দেখিয়া সকল ভক্ত আনন্দ-হিয়ায় ॥ ৮৮+৩ ॥

bhojana karaẏe prabhu tridaśera rāẏa |
dekhiẏā sakala bhakta ānanda-hiẏāẏa || 88+3 ||

bhojana karaye prabhu — the Lord eats; tridashera raya — the King of the gods; dekhiya sakala bhakta — seeing this, all the devotees; ananda-hiyaya — rejoice at heart

88+3The Lord, the King of the gods, eats,
and, seeing this, all the devotees rejoice at heart.

আর সব জন — যার যেই অনুরূপ ।
ভোজন করিলা সভে আনন্দ-কৌতুক ॥ ৮৯ ॥

āra saba jana — yāra yei anurūpa |
bhojana karilā sabhe ānanda-kautuka || 89 ||

ara saba jana — and all the others; yara yei anurupa — each as befitted him; bhojana karila sabhe — all ate; ananda-kautuka — in joy and merriment

89And all the others, each as befitted him,
ate in joy and merriment.

সন্ন্যাস করিলা প্রভু — কারো নাহি মনে ।
আনন্দে গোঙায় দিনরাতি সংকীর্তনে ॥ ৯০ ॥

sannyāsa karilā prabhu — kāro nāhi mane |
ānande goṅāẏa dinarāti saṃkīrtane || 90 ||

sannyasa karila prabhu — that the Lord had taken sannyasa; karo nahi mane — no one remembers; anande gongaya — joyfully they spend; dinarati sankirtane — days and nights in sankirtana

90No one remembers that the Lord has taken sannyasa:
joyfully they spend days and nights in sankirtana.

সংকীর্তনে ভোরা প্রভু নিজ-গুণ গায় ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে আপে নাচিয়ে নাচায় ॥ ৯১ ॥

saṃkīrtane bhorā prabhu nija-guṇa gāẏa |
ānanda-hṛdaẏe āpe nāciẏe nācāẏa || 91 ||

sankirtane bhora prabhu — the Lord, absorbed in sankirtana; nija-guna gaya — sings His own glories; ananda-hridaye — with a joyful heart; ape nachiye nachaya — dances Himself and makes others dance

91Absorbed in sankirtana, the Lord sings His own glories;20
with a joyful heart He dances Himself and makes others dance.

নাচে নিত্যানন্দ আর নাচে হরিদাস ।
মুরারি মুকুন্দ নাচে আর শ্রীনিবাস ॥ ৯১+১ ॥

nāce nityānanda āra nāce haridāsa |
murāri mukunda nāce āra śrīnibāsa || 91+1 ||

nache nityananda — Nityananda dances; ara nache haridasa — and Haridasa dances; murari mukunda nache — Murari and Mukunda dance; ara shrinivasa — and Srinivasa

91+1Nityananda dances, and Haridasa dances,21
Murari, Mukunda and Srinivasa dance;

গদাধর নরহরি নাচে তাঁর পাশ ।
বাসুদেব ঘোষ নাচে গদাধর দাস ॥ ৯১+২ ॥

gadādhara narahari nāce tāṁra pāśa |
bāsudeba ghoṣa nāce gadādhara dāsa || 91+2 ||

gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara [and] Narahari; nache tanra pasha — dance beside Him; vasudeva ghosha nache — Vasudeva Ghosha dances; gadadhara dasa — [and] Gadadhara Dasa

91+2beside Him Gadadhara and Narahari dance,
Vasudeva Ghosha and Gadadhara Dasa dance.

সব ভক্ত নাচে মোর গৌরাঙ্গ বেড়িয়া ।
গণিতে না পারি তা সভার নাম লৈয়া ॥ ৯১+৩ ॥

saba bhakta nāce mora gaurāṅga beṛiẏā |
gaṇite nā pāri tā sabhāra nāma laiẏā || 91+3 ||

saba bhakta nache — all the devotees dance; mora gauranga bediya — surrounding my Gauranga; ganite na pari — I cannot count; ta sabhara nama laiya — naming them all

91+3All the devotees dance around my Gauranga —
I cannot count them, naming them one by one.

অনন্ত গৌরাঙ্গ-সঙ্গী কে কহিতে পারে ।
সভাই বেড়িয়া নাচে প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ৯১+৪ ॥

ananta gaurāṅga-saṅgī ke kahite pāre |
sabhāi beṛiẏā nāce prabhu biśbambhare || 91+4 ||

ananta gauranga-sangi — countless are Gauranga's companions; ke kahite pare — who can name them; sabhai bediya nache — all dance around; prabhu vishvambhare — the Lord Vishvambhara

91+4Countless are Gauranga's companions — who can name them?
All dance around the Lord Vishvambhara.

সর্বভক্তগণ নাচে প্রেম-রস-রঙ্গে ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য নাচে নিজপুত্র-সঙ্গে ॥ ৯২ ॥

sarbabhaktagaṇa nāce prema-rasa-raṅge |
adbaita-ācārya nāce nijaputra-saṅge || 92 ||

sarva-bhakta-gana nache — all the devotees dance; prema-rasa-range — in the delight of prema's rasa; advaita-acharya nache — Advaita Acharya dances; nija-putra-sange — with His own son

92All the devotees dance in the delight of prema's rasa;
Advaita Acharya dances with His son.22

সভার হৃদয়ে প্রেম বাঢ়িল অপার ।
অশ্রু-কম্প-পুলকাদি সাত্ত্বিক-বিকার ॥ ৯৩ ॥

sabhāra hṛdaẏe prema bāṛhila apāra |
aśru-kampa-pulakādi sāttbika-bikāra || 93 ||

sabhara hridaye — in everyone's heart; prema badhila apara — prema grew boundlessly; ashru-kampa-pulaka-adi — tears, trembling, thrill and the rest; sattvika-vikara — the sattvika transformations

93In everyone's heart prema grew boundlessly —
tears, trembling, thrill and the other sattvika transformations.

সভার হৃদয়ে ভেল আনন্দ-উল্লাস ।
এত শুনি' সুখী এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৯৪ ॥

sabhāra hṛdaẏe bhela ānanda-ullāsa |
eta śuni' sukhī e locanadāsa || 94 ||

sabhara hridaye — in everyone's heart; bhela ananda-ullasa — joy and exultation arose; eta shuni — hearing this; sukhi e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa is happy

94In everyone's heart arose joy and exultation.
Hearing this, Lochana Dasa is happy.

✦

Notes

  1. The OCR of the summary is garbled in places; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface (ch. 14: "Chandrashekhara Acharya's coming from Kantakanagara to Nadia; the grief and lament of Mother Shachi and Vishnupriya; Nityananda Prabhu announces Mahaprabhu's coming to Shantipura; Nityananda Prabhu's conversation with Mother Shachi; the people of Nadia come to Advaita's house to see the Lord; Mahaprabhu speaks fittingly with everyone").
  2. Words of a mother's grief; cf. en/39, vv. 100+1–100+3. In the lila Keshava Bharati is the Lord's revered sannyasa-guru (en/39, note 10).
  3. Vishnupriya is the Lord's eternal consort, His Bhu-shakti (en/21, note 9); her separation from the Lord is not worldly grief (cf. en/38, note 5).
  4. Vv. 15+1 — 15+15 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have them.
  5. Lit. "whose vow is broken": Vishnupriya apparently reproaches herself for having failed in the vow of a faithful wife — to keep her husband and serve him.
  6. Lit. "all Your worthy women" — the women of Nadia devoted to the Lord; cf. en/09, note 9.
  7. V. 31+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have it.
  8. V. 32+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have it. Cf. en/38 (the Lord consoles Vishnupriya before His sannyasa).
  9. The Lord's name is not different from Him, yet it is more merciful than He, for it is open to all — a common teaching of the Gaudiya Vaishnavas.
  10. The independent Lord submits to the love of His devotees and to their chanting of His name.
  11. In the 1983 edition a new chapter, "Pastimes at Shantipura", begins at v. 46. Vv. 46–64 — cf. Murari 3.4.3–10.
  12. The customary greeting of sannyasis (en/39, note 7); cf. Murari 3.3.13. The 1983 edition reads "Namo narayanaya".
  13. Thakura here is Nityananda.
  14. Lit. "their backs broke". In Bhaktisiddhanta's edition the number of v. 65 is printed as "1"; the numbers of vv. 60 and 85 are missing, and vv. 62 and 92 are printed as 61 and 91 — restored.
  15. Vv. 71–90 — cf. Murari 3.4.12–23; Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 3.
  16. Vv. 75+1 — 75+5 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition vv. 75+2 — 75+5 are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. V. 75+1 is close to v. 76.
  17. Vv. 76+1 — 76+5 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition does not have them.
  18. Bhiksha is a sannyasi's meal, taken in a householder's home.
  19. Vv. 88+1 — 88+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Sita-devi is Advaita's wife; Narayani is probably Srivasa's niece, later the mother of Vrindavana Dasa (possibly also an epithet of Sita). The Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 3) also says that Shachi cooked at Advaita's house.
  20. The Lord is Himself Krishna; singing of Krishna, He sings of Himself.
  21. Vv. 91+1 — 91+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
  22. The 1983 edition has another redaction of this couplet: "Shachi watches happily together with Sita and Narayani; Advaita Acharya dances merrily with His son."
